title: Fed holds rates steady, signals two cuts later this year
text: Federal Reserve officials left the benchmark interest rate unchanged at the June meeting while the dot plot pointed to two quarter-point cuts before December.

title: Powell says inflation progress allows rate reductions
text: Fed Chair Jerome Powell told reporters that cooling inflation gives the central bank room to begin lowering borrowing costs, possibly in September.

title: Treasury yields climb as hot jobs report dents cut hopes
text: Bond yields rose after payrolls beat forecasts, leading traders to price fewer Federal Reserve rate cuts this year.

title: Bitcoin tops $100,000 for the first time
text: The largest cryptocurrency crossed the six-figure mark as ETF inflows accelerated and traders bet on a friendlier regulatory climate.

title: Spot bitcoin ETFs record $1 billion in daily inflows
text: US-listed spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds attracted more than one billion dollars in a single session, led by BlackRock's IBIT.

title: Crypto market slides as bitcoin falls below $90K
text: Bitcoin dropped sharply over the weekend, dragging ether and other tokens lower amid liquidations of leveraged long positions.

title: SEC approves spot ether ETFs
text: The Securities and Exchange Commission approved exchange-listed funds holding ether, a second major win for the crypto industry after bitcoin funds.

title: New poll shows challenger leading incumbent in swing states
text: A survey of likely voters in Pennsylvania, Michigan and Wisconsin found the challenger ahead by three points, within the margin of error.

title: Incumbent's campaign raises record sum in third quarter
text: The president's re-election campaign reported its strongest fundraising quarter, adding cash for advertising in battleground states.

title: Debate performance shakes up presidential race
text: Analysts said the televised debate shifted momentum, with betting markets moving several points toward the challenger afterwards.

title: Labour wins landslide in UK general election
text: Keir Starmer's Labour Party secured a large parliamentary majority, ending fourteen years of Conservative government.

title: Conservatives concede as exit poll projects heavy losses
text: The exit poll projected the Tories losing more than two hundred seats in the general election.

title: OpenAI releases new flagship model with improved reasoning
text: The company launched its latest large language model, claiming better performance on math and coding benchmarks.

title: Google unveils Gemini update at developer conference
text: Google showed a new version of its Gemini model family with longer context and multimodal features.

title: EU AI Act enters into force
text: The European Union's artificial intelligence regulation took effect, with obligations for general-purpose models phasing in over two years.

title: Celtics beat Mavericks to win NBA championship
text: Boston clinched the title in Game 5, securing the franchise's record eighteenth championship.

title: Mavericks star scores 40 but Dallas falls in Finals
text: Despite a big night from Luka Doncic, Dallas lost to Boston in the NBA Finals.

title: OPEC+ agrees to extend production cuts
text: The oil producers' alliance extended voluntary output reductions into next year to support crude prices.

title: Brent crude jumps after Middle East supply fears
text: Oil prices rose more than three percent as tensions raised concerns about shipping disruptions in the region.

title: Supreme Court upholds law forcing TikTok sale or ban
text: The justices unanimously upheld the statute requiring ByteDance to divest TikTok's US operations or face a ban.

title: TikTok goes dark for US users, then restores service
text: The app briefly stopped working in the United States before service was restored following assurances from the incoming administration.

title: Ukraine and Russia hold talks on ceasefire framework
text: Negotiators met in Istanbul to discuss a possible ceasefire, though officials said major differences remain on territory.

title: Kremlin rejects proposal for immediate truce
text: Russian officials dismissed a call for an unconditional thirty-day ceasefire, saying conditions were not in place.

title: S&P 500 closes at record high on tech rally
text: The benchmark index set a new all-time closing high, powered by gains in semiconductor and megacap technology shares.

title: Stocks tumble as tariff fears grip Wall Street
text: Equities sold off broadly after new import tariffs were announced, with the S&P 500 posting its worst day in months.

title: Nvidia market value surpasses $3 trillion
text: Shares of the chipmaker rose to a record, briefly making it the world's most valuable company on demand for AI accelerators.

title: Hurricane makes landfall on Gulf Coast as Category 3
text: The storm brought heavy rain and storm surge to coastal Louisiana, prompting evacuations.

title: Cardinals elect new pope after conclave
text: White smoke rose over the Sistine Chapel as the College of Cardinals chose a new pontiff on the second day of voting.
